versions.changelog:
- Initial release: delivers DORA metrics computation from git and GitHub API.
- Calculates Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, Change Failure Rate, and Time to Restore Service.
- Classifies each metric (Elite, High, Medium, Low) and highlights the bottleneck for improvement.
- Supports JSON and human-readable output; integrates with external trend visualization.
- Includes thorough guidance for usage, verification, and tier thresholds.
